post.title: Zero-Downtime Schema Migrations: The Expand-Contract Pattern for Live Production DBs
post.subtitle: Learn how to evolve relational database schemas under live traffic using the Expand-Contract pattern in Spring Boot.
post.brief: Altering database schemas in a high-traffic production system without downtime requires the Expand-Contract pattern. Instead of changing a column in place, we add a new column (Expand), double-write to both columns via the application (Transition), backfill historical data, and finally remove the old column (Contract). This guide details this lifecycle with full Spring Boot and Liquibase snippets.
